content.ascii:
[P1] Content revisions, placement alternatives, and review
|
|-- Immutable content
|   |-- DiagramRevision: identity, ancestry, Diagram, nodeRefs
|   |-- Diagram: ASCII, parsed structure, source mappings and evidence
|   `-- nodeRefs preserve proven logical nodes across revisions
|
|-- Revision lifecycle
|   |-- create / revise / derive -> validated, frozen revision
|   |-- runtime store retains revisions; generation and supplied edits
|   |   `-- produce retained candidates from explicit inputs
|   `-- controller publishes a bound revision to canvas history
|       `-- checkpoints and persistence retain referenced revisions
|
|-- Placement presentation: document.alternatives
|   |-- alternative pins revision and base for whole diagram or subtree
|   |-- multiple parts form one atomic choice; choices may nest
|   |-- selected IDs are independent for each placement
|   |-- projection composes displayed rows from selected choices
|   `-- side panels pin a part for regular or diff comparison
|       Display selection preserves the bound content revision.
|
`-- Review: document.revisionReviews
    |-- retained candidate + base/head + accept/reject decisions
    |-- saving decisions preserves the bound content revision
    |-- applying checks dependencies and conflicts, then binds result
    `-- optional alternative.reviewId connects display and review

Content changes, display choices, and review decisions are distinct.
Canvas history records their effects; revision payloads stay immutable.
